content: QR-code wayfinding works offline once the map is cached (ExpoFP 2026 comparison table: works offline = yes, once map is cached), while BLE is only partially offline (app required) and Wi-Fi/UWB needs a live connection. Academic work on offline 2D indoor navigation (Veloz et al., MDPI Informatics 12(2):34, 2025) treats connectivity loss inside complex layouts as a first-class problem solved by pre-storing map and route data on device. Practical consequence for this project: the client needs a cached graph plus cached floor images, and route computation must either run on device or against a locally cached graph when the network is unavailable, rather than failing outright.
